message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on any data fetched or read from CSV files; the code simply reads and processes data without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from the nba_api and remote URLs without any checksum verification, signature validation, pinned API versions, or authentication of the remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only drops rows with null WL values in csv_cleaner.py but never validates label distributions, checks for unexpected label values, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the data preparation pipeline; csv_cleaner.py only removes rows with missing WL fields.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle to serialize/deserialize models (implied by 'import pickle' in both gameOutcomePredictor.py and teamStatsPredictor.py) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before loading any serialized model files.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only drops rows with null WL values in csv_cleaner.py but never checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the codebase.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training data, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation is performed on data flowing into the prediction functions before model inference.

No detected output bounds checks: Predicted values (e.g., predictedAssists, predictedTurnovers, etc.) are directly assigned to teamInfo without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on model outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML models (LogisticRegression, DecisionTreeClassifier, LinearRegression, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
